scope: Inert endpoint proposal and source contracts only; no Adult endpoint run or numerical V2 replay
queue_gate: All 58 attack parents and release/source parents must be DONE with exit 0; output hashes and every V2 receipt/model/probe file are source-pinned before INNER labels open
frozen_view_gate: Attack index COMPLETE with r1/r2/pair V2 PASS; exact pre-INNER freeze, view, reader receipt, saved matrix, reader order, coalition alias and prediction custody
v2_gate: Each private V2 receipt must have frozen schema/status, identical ATT/INNER view hashes and exact three hashed shuffled/planted model and probe files; the private normalized source binding records each V2 receipt SHA
independent_followup: R04 numerical replay will reforward fixed readers and V2 probes and recompute AUC before scientific interpretation
